BiblicalUsage: Keran, Cheran, is a son of Dishon, named in the genealogy of Edom. Genesis 36:26 lists the children of Dishon: Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran. 1 Chronicles 1:41 repeats the line: the sons of Dishon, Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Cheran is kept in the record because God counts the families of Edom as carefully as he counts the families of Israel.
